  - Five stacked small text lines above the tiles.
  - Ragged tile rows, 9 on top and 3 below.
  - 14–15px text, below the 16px floor.
  - Boxed badge chips that look like buttons.
  - A "Copy report" button that is a dev action.
  - No A/B pad glyphs on the buttons.

I logged all of this in `tools/handoff/console/notes/ui/end-cards.md`. The next step is a `cw-endcard-clean` ship: the 16px text floor, one "recovered" line, and un-boxed badges.
